method: Read the whole spec at commit 78e35627, the brief, the lap-2 review context, and the lap-1 outcomes in docs/decisions/decision-changelog.md. Checked all 22 evidence quotes with the shared quote script (22/22 verbatim). Read the cited app code: web/e2e/player-states.ts, player.e2e.ts, a11y.e2e.ts, pages.vr.ts, page-errors.ts, web/playwright.e2e.config.ts, web/app/play/PlayerShell.tsx, OpenFileControl.tsx, NotationSurface.tsx, PlayerShell.test.tsx, web/app/page.tsx, web/lib/alphatab/AlphaTabEngineContext.tsx, engine.ts, useAlphaTab.ts, web/scripts/vendor-alphatab.mjs, eslint.config.base.mjs and package.json; the installed AlphaTab 1.8.4 dist (alphaTab.core.mjs and alphaTab.core.min.mjs), react-dom 19.2.7, Next.js 16.3.6, Sonner 2.0.7 (via client/), and the Sentry 11.0.0 mirror (browser and nextjs). Ran: grep traces of every helper caller, setOpening call and setAnnouncement call; a Node script over the real ACCEPT list; Node runs of the minified AlphaTab parser over 175 failing loads at stack limits 10 and 50; a jsdom run of React 19.2.7 with an effect throw and a click throw under an error boundary; and Playwright 1.61.1 with Chromium 149, which could not hide a page in four tries, so the background-tab case was emulated by holding back animation-frame and observer callbacks around the installed AlphaTab. Tables were re-padded the way Prettier does after checking that the current tables round-trip byte for byte. No repository file was changed apart from this output.

spike.what: Playwright 1.61.1 with Chromium 149 (headless shell and new headless). First, four ways to hide a page — a second page brought to front, a CDP background target, a CDP hidden target, a minimised window — all stayed `visible`, so a real hidden tab could not be made. Then an emulation: a page loads the installed minified AlphaTab 1.8.4 laid out as web/scripts/vendor-alphatab.mjs serves it, with core.file = /notation/1-beat.gp, while requestAnimationFrame, ResizeObserver and IntersectionObserver callbacks are held back (the "update the rendering" work a hidden page has no opportunity to run) and a 3 s timer stands in for the 60 s one.
spike.result: Control run: scoreLoaded at 81 ms, renderFinished at 112 ms. Held run: the font was requested, but the score was never fetched and neither scoreLoaded nor renderFinished fired in 5 s, while the 3 s timer fired at 3033 ms. Releasing the held callbacks ("showing the tab"): scoreLoaded +19 ms, renderFinished +31 ms. Limit: holding requestAnimationFrame alone let AlphaTab's ResizeObserver path fire an empty-score renderFinished at 92 ms; a hidden page defers both.

| `web/app/play/PlayerShell.tsx`, both restore paths | saved settings or transport repaired, or unreadable | E601/E603 | warning          |

**E204 counts visible time only.** AlphaTab 1.8.4 starts its first render from an animation
frame, and a browser runs none in a hidden tab, so a player opened in a background tab draws
nothing there while a plain timer keeps counting. The 60 seconds therefore run only while
`document.visibilityState` is `visible`: the clock stops on `visibilitychange` to `hidden`,
continues with the time left when the page is visible again, and stops for good at the first
`renderFinished`. Without this, a background tab left for a minute sends an unhandled E204 that
lowers the health number although nothing failed.

| `web/app/play/PlayerShell.tsx`, both restore paths | saved settings or transport repaired, or unreadable | E601/E603 | warning          |

**E204 counts visible time only.** AlphaTab 1.8.4 starts its first render from an animation
frame, and a browser runs none in a hidden tab, so a player opened in a background tab draws
nothing there while a plain timer keeps counting. The clock is therefore cleared whenever the page
is hidden and started again from 60 seconds each time it becomes visible, until the first
`renderFinished` stops it for good. Without this, a background tab left for a minute sends an
unhandled E204 that lowers the health number although nothing failed.

items.scenario: You Cmd-click Play on the home page, so the player opens in a background tab, and you keep reading for two minutes. At 60 seconds that hidden tab sends Sentry an unhandled E204, "the music font did not arrive within 60 seconds", although nothing failed: the owner gets a new-issue email and your visit counts against the health number. When you switch to the tab, the score draws within a moment.
items.corrections: None to the claim. Precision: the backstop waits for any renderFinished, not for the font; the font itself downloads in a hidden tab (seen in the spike). What stalls is AlphaTab's first render.
items.notes_for_triage: Option 1 (pause and resume) keeps the full 60 visible seconds; option 2 (restart at every return to the tab) is less code, but a visitor who switches tabs often gets E204 later. Pitfall for both: the clock must stop for good at the first renderFinished — a visibility listener that re-arms it afterwards would raise a false E204 a minute after any tab switch. The test bullet is optional and needs a new web/app/play/NotationSurface.test.tsx (hence the §1 line 92-93 change). Drop: background-tab visits keep sending unhandled E204s, using quota, lowering the health number, and emailing the owner on the first one.

spike.result: Most non-score files (PDF, image, ZIP, random, text over about 30 bytes): `at Fi.loadScoreFromBytes (alphaTab.core.mjs:51:469500)`, then our frame. A tiny or empty file, or a truncated score: `at Le.yi (alphaTab.core.mjs:51:217498)`, `at Le.read` or `Le.readByte`, then minified importer frames (`ks.gpReadStringByteLength`, `ys.readVersion`, `je.gn`, `Ye.vn` ...), up to 12 engine frames above ours. With Sentry's limit of 50, our frame is present in 175 of 175 loads; with V8's default of 10 it is missing in 61 of 175 (truncated .gp, .mxl and .gp5 files).
